name: Kawasaki Ninja ZX-6R
engine: 599 or 636 cc liquid-cooled inline four, carbs (to 2002) or fuel injected
intro: Kawasaki's long-running middleweight. Carbs on early bikes, EFI later. 2009-2012 bikes had a regulator/rectifier recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2009-2012 ZX-6R bikes are in recall 12V064 because the regulator/rectifier may not charge the battery properly.
A-002.reason: A flat battery can stall the engine. The fix is free.

G: Bikes up to 2002 have carbs. Later bikes are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match.

recalls.what: Regulator/rectifier may not charge the battery enough.
